+def compute_grad(points, s):
+    n = len(points)
+    grad = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)] * n
+    for i in range(n):
+        xi, yi, zi = points[i]
+        for j in range(i + 1, n):
+            xj, yj, zj = points[j]
+            dx = xi - xj
+            dy = yi - yj
+            dz = zi - zj
+            d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
+            if d2 < 1e-20:

+            f = s / (d2 * d2)
+            grad[i] = (grad[i][0] + f * dx, grad[i][1] + f * dy, grad[i][2] + f * dz)
+            grad[j] = (grad[j][0] - f * dx, grad[j][1] - f * dy, grad[j][2] - f * dz)
